stage_name_zh: 阶段 4：顶会论文、具身智能/生成建模、学术演讲与全周期综合复习（Day 76–116）
learning_objectives_zh: 全周期巩固第 101 天预定间隔复习词群，强化多义辨析与跨场景（AI/时序/具身智能论文、演讲、六级/雅思托福）主动写作。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G029】语篇信息流推进（Given-New Contract）与跨句主题链构建；【G034】四大常见表达病灶诊断：口语化、过度表达（Over-expression）、不精确表达与指代悬空。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP005】描述系统模块、数据集或分类体系的构成，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 语篇信息流推进（Given-New Contract）与跨句主题链构建
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 地道英语段落之所以流畅自然、毫无生硬拼接感，核心在于遵守“旧信息在前（Given）、新信息在后（New）”的信息契约，用总结性指代或语态转换实现句间无缝咬合。
rules: 链式推进（Linear Progression）：第 N 句句末引入的新概念（如 an anomaly in the sensor readings），在第 N+1 句句首打包为旧信息主语（This anomaly / Such discrepancies...）。
避免连续多句使用毫无关联的全新长主语，造成读者认知断层。
examples: An anomaly in the sensor readings prompted a check of the calibration procedure. This check revealed a drift in the reference voltage.
common_errors: 把旧信息放在句末，而把长达 15 词的全新复杂概念硬塞在句首主语位置。

grammar_instruction.name: 四大常见表达病灶诊断：口语化、过度表达（Over-expression）、不精确表达与指代悬空
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 针对中国学习者在论文、雅思托福及六级写作中的四大高频失分点建立系统修正机制：(1) 口语化表达混入书面语，(2) 过度表达（语义重复或情态过满），(3) 不精确表达（缺少比较基准、分母或时间单位），(4) 悬空指代。
rules: 修正口语化（Colloquialism）：书面论文中将 a lot of 改为 substantial / a large number of；将 get 改为 obtain / acquire；将 big 改为 substantial / marked；将 do a study 改为 conduct / carry out a study；将 pretty up / dumb down 改为 refine the visual layout / oversimplify。
修正过度表达与语义冗余（Over-expression & Pleonasm）：禁止写 *halve by 50%*（halve 已含 50%）、*mutually collaborate with each other*、*completely eliminate all*、*future forthcoming*。
修正不精确表达（Imprecision）：报告 lag（滞后）、rate（速率）或 relative change（相对变化）时，必须指明采样时间单位（sampling interval）、基线（baseline）与分母（denominator）。
examples:
口语化病句：*We did a small study and got a lot of data, which pretty up our paper.*
修正：*We conducted a pilot study and collected a substantial amount of data to test the protocol.*

不精确病句：*The error dropped by 5%.*
精确修正：*The classification error rate decreased by 5 percentage points (from 20% to 15%) relative to the baseline.*
common_errors: 把口头演讲过渡语（如 *Getting back to the question / That is all very well, but*）直接写进正式期刊论文正文。
混淆相对百分比变化（per cent）与绝对百分点变化（percentage points）。

grammar_instruction.name: 冠词系统（a/an, the, 零冠词）与学术特指/泛指边界
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 冠词决定名词短语的指称范围：单数可数泛指用 a/an；指代本研究特定样本/模型（the sample, the model）或带 of 后置限定的属性（the accuracy of the measurements, the nature of the task）用 the；复数可数或不可数表普遍概念用零冠词。
rules: 单数可数名词在句中不可裸奔（bare singular），必须带冠词或限定词（a limitation, the protocol, each trajectory）。
注意冠词改变词义：nature（零冠词）指“大自然”，而 the nature of the problem 指“问题的基本性质”；in charge of（主动负责） vs in the charge of（由他人看管负责）。
图表编号直接作专名指称时不加 the（see Table 1, Figure 2 shows），但普通名词需加冠词（in the table below）。
examples: Equity is an abstract concept that requires an operational definition.
The nature of the task determines which measures are appropriate.
As can be seen in Table 1, the groups differ in size.
common_errors: 单数可数名词漏掉冠词：*We conducted survey / *Trained model achieved lower error。
图表编号前误加冠词：*See the Table 2（应为 See Table 2）。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 描述系统模块、数据集或分类体系的构成
expression_pattern_instruction.template: [Whole System/Dataset] consists of / comprises [N] components, whereas [Subset] accounts for / constitutes [Proportion].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用主动语态的 consist of / comprise 表整体由部分组成，用 constitute / account for 表部分占整体的比例。
examples: The questionnaire consists of three sections.
Missing responses account for a small proportion of the records.

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 使用 be of + 抽象名词结构自然提升评价语域
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 自然替换口语化的 be very important/useful。
examples: The consent procedure is of particular significance to this study.
The evidence is of great relevance to the policy debate.
common_errors: *be of important（of 后必须接名词 importance）。

key_collocations: be deeply critical of a conclusion
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The reviewer was deeply critical of the unsupported conclusion.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：defer 后接名词或动名词，延期通常须按规定申请。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The student requested permission to defer submission of the dissertation.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：通常用 delve into；在学术文体中可以使用，但 examine/analyse 更直接，避免把它当作装饰性动词。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The next section delves into the assumptions behind the estimator.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：democrat 和 democracy 拼写不同；democratize 可用。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The project examines changes in democratic institutions.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：不是 depart off。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The revision departs from the original plan.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：heavily 表示程度，不是物理重量。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The estimate depends heavily on the sampling frame.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：depend on表示依赖/取决于；本文be depended on表示可被可靠使用。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The accuracy of the reading may depend on the weather.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00710 n. phr.] 因变量（例：Reaction time was the dependent variable.）；[V00711 n. phr.] 因变量；被解释或测量的结果变量（例：Reading accuracy was the dependent variable.） | 本条用法约束：研究中测量的结果变量；不是研究者直接施加的处理。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Reaction time was the dependent variable.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00710 n. phr.] 因变量（例：Reaction time was the dependent variable.）；[V00711 n. phr.] 因变量；被解释或测量的结果变量（例：Reading accuracy was the dependent variable.） | 本条用法约束：dependence 不自动表示因果依赖，需结合研究设计。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Reading accuracy was the dependent variable.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：来自depend on；正文depending为现在分词。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The interpretation may change depending on the context.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：derive X from Y；被动 X is derived from Y。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Researchers can derive information from historical records.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：that 后为句子；despite 单独后常接名词。
key_collocations: despite the fact that it is costly
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The scheme was adopted despite the fact that it was costly.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：deviation 为名词。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The largest observation deviates from the mean by ten units.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：compare findings with findings，用those避免重复。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: These findings differ from those reported in the earlier study.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：通常写the difference between A and B；differences in X则标明差异所在特征。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The difference between the two designs concerns sampling.
